notes:
What's new in Vekrun 0.4.9 — Fewer surprises

• Vekrun asks before it removes anything: Work Items from the list, schedules, triggers, connections, MCP servers, extensions, memories, conversations, snapshots, branches and more. The question says what goes, what stays, and whether it can be undone.
• Lima installs by itself when Vekrun starts (one time, about a minute — its official build, checked against its published checksum, no administrator rights), so Factory runs are ready without a click.
• Fixed: Honeybadger through the browser sign-in only brought in the newest errors. It now reads all of an application's active errors, and every connection reads its history once more after this update.
• Fixed: Datadog's "Sign in with browser" said Datadog had no browser sign-in. (An organisation admin must have MCP access turned on in Datadog.)
• Updating a coding CLI is one click, refreshes Homebrew first so the newest version is found, and says so plainly if the version didn't change instead of reporting success.
